download_model_from_url: download a model file from a URL to a local path with caching support
download_zip_model_and_extract: download a zipped model from a URL and extract it to a local directory
cache_check_before_download: check if a model file is already cached locally before downloading from a URL
download_model_to_custom_root: download a model from a URL to a custom path_root directory instead of checkpoints
summarize_get_model_from_url: summarize the get_model_from_url function that downloads and optionally unzips model files from URLs
